## Problem
Customers using orders-service cannot see the free-cancellation window of an order, so they miss it and pay a fee.

## Proposed Outcome
Every order shows the end of its free-cancellation window.

## Affected Users And Systems
- Users: customers and support agents
- Services: `orders-service`, `payments-service`

## Constraints
- Windows come from merchant terms and are never invented.

## Open Questions
- None.

## Source
- Origin: idea from the product team
- Author: product team

## Intent
`.pipes/project/01-intents/intent-901-cancellation-deadline.md`: orders show the end of their free-cancellation window.

## Requirements
- **R1** The order response of `orders-service` includes the end of the free-cancellation window when the merchant terms define one.
- **R2** The window end is shown in UTC.

## Design
### orders-service
- Change: add `cancellationDeadline` to the saved offer.

## Risk Class
routine: one consumer.
